checks.name: Actual v7-to-v8 subpath upgrade deletes old cache and both previously cached en5 assets
Secondary-model checkbox and comparison UI are absent; ready message names one recognition model
Image plus two-page PDF detect locally; pending/active ordering and navigation use page order
Real OCR returns only small6 with four variants; page/result ordering, clipboard and TXT/CSV export work
Controlled primary-only candidates highlight substitutions/insertions/deletions; adoption keeps raw output and baseline
390px layout and footer preserve readable differences, attribution and all nine local license links
Controlled hostile and case-sensitive candidates stay text-only within primary candidate table
Cold offline restart with server stopped parses PDF, detects, recognizes only small6 and reorders pages
Final source matches cached code; no v8 en5 requests, uploads, external requests or input cache entries

real_ocr.test_data: Readable synthetic serial images and a two-page synthetic PDF; no user files.

controlled_ui_tests.scope: Primary-only candidate display, red character differences, deletion markers, adoption, fixed baseline and text-only rendering.

limits: Chromium desktop at 390px is not a physical iPhone/Android/Safari test.
Three readable synthetic serials are not a representative accuracy benchmark.
Relevant two-page PDF integration exercised; full existing PDF compatibility and large-batch capacity suites not repeated.
